title: v6a 快速微调配方预注册
purpose: Fast recipe check: fine-tune v3 A on 100k balanced mined dataset (50k abnormal + 50k hard-normal >0.5) to see whether the new hard-normal pool can reduce val over-alarm without breaking recall/calibration.

recipe.name: v6a
recipe.init: load best_resnet_large_clean_baseline_v3.h5, then fine-tune all layers

data.normal_source: hard-normal pool (v3 A score > 0.5) + stratified source quotas
data.note: no test/val data; all from train-safe mined pool

recipe.val_for_early_stopping: v3 A val split (distill_pilot_teacher_targets.npz x_val/y_val), 4040 beats
recipe.loss: sparse categorical crossentropy (hard labels only, no KD)

real_afe_holdout_not_worse.criterion: mean_prob <= max(0.10, baseline_mean + 0.02) AND frac_gt_0.5 <= baseline_frac_gt_0.5

theta05_false_alarm_not_worse.criterion: val pooled normal frac>0.5 increase <= +0.02; pure-normal record alert blocks <= baseline

verdict_semantics.PASS: primary + guardrail A/B/C + calibration protection all pass
verdict_semantics.PARTIAL: primary passes but at least one guardrail/calibration gate breaks
verdict_semantics.UNPROVEN: primary does not pass or recipe impossible; not called disproven

known_limitations: fine-tune from v3 A may be faster but could preserve existing biases
100k is a fast subset; if signal appears, expand to 200k-400k
